answer: Make every agent post its own refundable bond. A newcomer locks 100 POA that the network holds like water behind a trellis: one bond, one identity, and the bond returns only after five clean epochs. A farm of 1,000 clones must lock 100,000 POA up front, and one proven cheat burns its bond, sending a ripple through the cluster as each fake identity costs real money instead of free words. Honest agents get every coin back and work in a calm lagoon, while a sybil farmer pays for each mask and cannot afford the wardrobe.
